why: Immutable body/attachment identities must remain valid when the desktop uses hardware Canvas. GPU resampling of staging frames changed every sleep-family body pose hash and rejected composition before gameplay.
fix: Request willReadFrequently on body staging and resampling canvases; preserve exact attachment validation and leave the world rendering context unchanged.
observedBaseline: On Metal with the original preparation code, all 48 body frame hashes differed from bundled hair ownership. Complete composition threw Hair ownership differs from the complete body family.
verification: Both recorded backends pass 96 immutable hair pose comparisons and 96 complete v5/v6 poses with hat and facial-hair recipes.
limits: Not visual approval of all composed pixels, every body family, every browser or every GPU; hardware performance measurement remains separate.
